rules.statement: A fidei commissum can be enforced against a purchaser from a fiduciarius who has a partition title, provided the purchaser had no notice of the fidei commissum.
rules.supporting_quote: "Although my decision on question (c) disposes of the case in favour of the respondent, I have thought it desirable to add a few words on the 444 other questions raised in this appeal, (b) raises the question as to whether a valid fidei commissum was created by P 3. It has been contended by Mr. Perera that the learned District Judge came to a wrong conclusion in finding that P 3 created a valid fidei commissum."
